preRegistered: squad18-core.mjs header + RULES (24 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json SQ18-*
standard: trade rules: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock at the same moments (capped +300%, AUD-1), better than the same stock on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital above SPY -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.07 -> PROVEN. Contribution rules: BETTER TIMING only with a positive monthly advantage and a larger basket account than first-day buying in both halves and t >= 2.

SQ18-PB12-CALM.name: Leader 12% pullback (SQ11-PB12), skipped on market-stress closes (hold 126)
SQ18-PB12-CALM.rule: SQ11-PB12 signals, SKIPPED when the market is under stress at the signal close: SPY closes 2%+ down, or VIXY closes 15%+ up, or 5+ active IBD distribution days (SPY 0.2%+ down on higher volume than the session before, retired once SPY closes 5%+ above it) among the last 25 sessions. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ18-PB12-MON.name: Leader 12% pullback (SQ11-PB12), Thursday/Friday signals bought at the next week's first open (hold 126)
SQ18-PB12-MON.rule: SQ11-PB12 signals; a signal at a Thursday or Friday close is bought at the open of the first session of the next calendar week (Monday, or Tuesday after a holiday) instead of the next open; sell at the close of session 126 from the actual buy. Other signals unchanged.

SQ18-FRIDIP.name: Leader falls 2%+ on a Friday while SPY falls less than 1%; buy Monday open (hold 21)
SQ18-FRIDIP.rule: Leader (top 20% by 12-1 month return among the 300 largest US companies by market value at the prior month end, as SQ11). Signal: on a Friday close, the leader closes 2%+ under its previous close while SPY closes better than -1%. Buy the next open (Monday); sell at the close of session 21; one open trade per stock.

SQ18-PB12-ACCUM.name: Leader 12% pullback (SQ11-PB12), only when market accumulation days >= distribution days (hold 126)
SQ18-PB12-ACCUM.rule: SQ11-PB12 signals, kept only when, over the last 25 sessions (signal close included), SPY accumulation days (0.2%+ up on higher volume than the session before) >= distribution days (0.2%+ down on higher volume). Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ18-PB12-DRY.name: Leader 12% pullback (SQ11-PB12) on shrinking volume only (hold 126)
SQ18-PB12-DRY.rule: SQ11-PB12 signals, kept only when the stock's average volume over the last 10 sessions (t-9..t) is below its average volume over the 50 sessions before them (t-59..t-10). Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ18-MTUM-CALM.name: MSCI-style momentum (SQ6-MTUM), buy delayed while the market is stressed (hold to the base exit, 126)
SQ18-MTUM-CALM.rule: SQ6-MTUM picks (last session of May / November). When the market is under stress at the formation close (as SQ18-PB12-CALM), buy at the open after the first calm close among the next 21 sessions (else after the 21st); sell at the base trade's exit (the close of session 126 from the base buy).

SQ18-QMOM-CALM.name: Quantitative momentum (SQ6-QMOM), buy delayed while the market is stressed (hold to the base exit, 63)
SQ18-QMOM-CALM.rule: SQ6-QMOM picks (last session of Feb / May / Aug / Nov). When the market is under stress at the formation close (as SQ18-PB12-CALM), buy at the open after the first calm close among the next 21 sessions (else after the 21st); sell at the base trade's exit (the close of session 63 from the base buy).

SQ18-BASK-DIP3.name: Monthly 1,000 USD into the halal basket: buy after the first 3% SPY dip of the month (else the last session)
SQ18-BASK-DIP3.rule: Each month: buy the halal top-20 basket (SQ10-SH20-C15) at the open after the first close of the month (first to second-to-last session) that is 3%+ under SPY's highest close since the previous month's last close; if none, at the open of the month's last session. Compared with buying at the open of the month's first session.

SQ18-BASK-MID.name: Monthly 1,000 USD into the halal basket: buy mid-month (first session on or after the 15th)
SQ18-BASK-MID.rule: Each month: buy the halal top-20 basket (SQ10-SH20-C15) at the open of the first session on or after the 15th. Compared with buying at the open of the month's first session.

SQ18-BASK-END.name: Monthly 1,000 USD into the halal basket: buy at the month's last session (before turn-of-month inflows)
SQ18-BASK-END.rule: Each month: buy the halal top-20 basket (SQ10-SH20-C15) at the open of the month's last session. Compared with buying at the open of the month's first session.
